facts.text: No more bets, boys. The dog ate the squeaky toy, the diamond is gone, and I need a cup of tea.
facts.why: Not a Turkish line. His real line on Wikiquote about the dog is 'Couldn't stand that squeaking anymore.' It works as a note, since the dog does swallow the diamond and the vet finds a squeaky toy too.
facts.fix: No more bets, boys. The dog ate the squeaky toy and the diamond, and I need a cup of tea.

facts.text: Serve the mains when the dog swallows the squeaky toy.
facts.why: Turkish only says the vet later found a squeaky toy in the dog. The swallowing that plays on screen is the diamond, which the dog swallows for real before it runs out the window.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when the dog swallows the diamond.
